guides.title: Monitoring absolute environmental sustainability
guides.purpose: Compare user-defined CE performance trajectories with allocated carrying capacities through annual and cumulative Absolute Sustainability Ratios (ASRs).

expected_contents.name: annual_asr.parquet
expected_contents.description: Annual regional and global environmental burdens, allocated carrying capacities, ASRs, and compliance indicators.

expected_contents.name: manifest.json
expected_contents.description: Completion record, LCA and aCC input identities, selected cases, and output hashes.

inputs: Completed run_lca results and allocated carrying capacities calculated with pyaesa through the tutorial workflow or supplied by the user, stored in data_raw/allocated_cc/results/<name>.
tables_and_schemas: Each table identifies the foreground, background, aCC case, region, and impact category. Annual rows include year; cumulative rows include period_start and period_end.
Annual results include 2019 for reporting; assessed_for_compliance marks the 2020--2100 assessment years.
units_signs_and_identifiers: Scores and allocated carrying capacities use matching native LCIA units. Signed scores are retained.
ASR <= 1 indicates compliance; ASR > 1 indicates transgression. Case labels identify the supplied allocated carrying capacity inputs.
The global row divides separately summed regional burdens and allocated carrying capacities.
guides.pandas_example:
import pandas as pd
annual = pd.read_parquet(result_directory / 'annual_asr.parquet')
cumulative = pd.read_parquet(result_directory / 'cumulative_gwp100_asr.parquet')
reuse_and_refresh: A repeated request reuses its completed result. Use refresh=True to recalculate only the selected ASR results.
Completed aCC inputs are immutable: supply corrected allocated carrying capacities under a new allocated_cc_result name.
scientific_limitations: Annual assessment covers all sixteen EF v3.1 categories and 12 world regions. Cumulative climate assessment additionally covers 2019--2100.
The cumulative denominator is the separately supplied allocated carrying capacity for 2019--2100.
Ensure consistent functional units, geographical boundaries, and allocation choices between environmental burdens and allocated carrying capacities.
